report.summary: All four failures are timeouts on pages that render the book list. The app's /books rendering calls list_books(), which sleeps a random 0-8 s when BUGS includes slow_list, so requests exceed the 5 s Playwright timeout only some of the time. Do not treat this as a product bug or a test bug: first confirm whether BUGS=slow_list was set for this run (the workflow file does not set it), then remove the random delay or make the UI tests wait for the list response instead of a 5 s default.

causes.title: Random multi-second delay in book listing exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() sleeps random.uniform(0, 8) seconds when the slow_list bug flag is on (app/main.py:160-161). render_books() calls list_books() on every /books render (app/main.py:270), and the POST /register and POST /books redirects land on /books, so every UI flow that reaches the book list depends on that delay. tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7 sets the default Playwright timeout to 5000 ms, so any draw above about 5 s fails. Two failures are page.goto('/books') waiting for the load event, and two are clicks that wait for the post-submit navigation to /books to finish. The outcome depends on the random draw, so the same code can pass on a rerun; the passing UI tests in this run (for example test_existing_user_can_log_in and test_deleted_book_disappears) fit that pattern. The workflow in .github/workflows/tests.yml does not set BUGS, so the delay is only active if slow_list was enabled in this environment. If it was not, the slowness has to come from the CI machine, which would make this infrastructure rather than app behavior.

tests.ui.test_login_ui::test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf[chromium]: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... click action done, waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (tests\support\pages.py:22)
app/main.py:311 and 350: register and add-book both return RedirectResponse("/books", status_code=303)
.github/workflows/tests.yml:33-38: pytest run sets no BUGS environment variable
causes.suggested_fix: 1) Confirm the environment: check whether BUGS contains slow_list in this run's CI config or local shell. 2) If it is set on purpose for triage/demo, treat this as a known flaky setup and do not run the UI suite with it, or raise the Playwright timeout for these flows. 3) If it is not set, the app is not the cause: check CI machine load and the app start time, and look at uvicorn logs. 4) Either way, do not raise timeouts blindly; make the tests wait for a specific signal (for example, the books list or the URL) with a timeout that covers the worst-case delay, and remove the random delay from the seeded-bug code path when it is not being tested.
